label: Scene Template: Process Flow / Charged Rail
description: WHOLE-SCENE template: a process told as energy traveling a rail. The rail draws across the lower third; a glowing spark charges it segment by segment; each node ignites as its step TAKES OVER the frame above in giant type (numbered, word-revealed, meta line). Use for how-it-works, setup steps, pipelines, any 3-6 step sequence. The rail is the persistent through-line object. Dark by default.
